product_metadata.title: Spoontiques – Cotton Apron
features: Cook In Style – Add a splash of fantastic flair to your kitchen attire with an apron from Spoontiques. Spoontiques aprons come in a variety of prints and are adorned with some of your favorite characters from superheroes to sitcoms!

High Quality Material – Spoontiques chef’s apron is constructed of 100% cotton. Apron is soft to the touch and comfortable to wear. Protect your clothes from any messes or spills while cooking, washing, or doing any kitchen work.

Tie Back – Spoontiques cooking aprons feature a back tie and a standard neck loop. Aprons are one size fits most and measure 31” in length. A convient pocket is a perfect place for your phone or your favorite recipe.
Machine Washable - These vibrant aprons are machine washable. In order to best care for the apron, please machine wash on cold and tumble dry on low or hang to dry.
Great Gift – Spoontiques aprons make excellent gifts! Surprise the chef or home cook in your life with a fun apron that fits their personality or fandom.
